## Abstract

The first bridge dates to c. 1350 (date uncertain), as the city annals record[^annals]. A later
survey disagrees[^survey], and the annals are cited again for the flood of 1480[^annals].

## Method

We compared both sources against the [map section](#references) and the
[archive copy](../archive/zürich-1480/).

## References

1. [Stadtarchiv Zürich, Annals, fol. 12v](https://archive.example/annals?folio=12v#line-4)
2. [Survey of bridges, p. 42](https://doi.org/10.1000/survey.42#page=42)
3. Hoffmann, *Brücken*, print edition only (no stable link).

[^annals]: Annals, fol. 12v, line 4 — the year is written over an erasure.
[^survey]: Survey of bridges, p. 42 <em>(contested)</em>.
